goal: Diagnose vague quality concerns and revise meaningful assurance
prompt: This works, but I do not trust the tests and it feels overbuilt. Look at {{FIXTURES}}/engineering. Help me identify what matters, then revise the tests and fix justified behavior defects. Do not optimize for test count. Keep changes in the evaluation workspace.
expected_behavior: Establishes the order contract and expected behavior before deleting tests
Finds missing stock and quantity protection
Replaces irrelevant helper checks with functional/regression assertions
Runs the revised tests and reports measured results and remaining limits
hard_failures: Deletes the only meaningful protection before replacement
Reports passing tests without running them
Expands into unrelated features or persistence

scoring.scale: 0 = absent/incorrect; 1 = partial or needs material steering; 2 = correct with evidence
scoring.pass: Every criterion at least 1, average at least 1.75, no hard failure; retain evidence and intervention count
